subject: Inbound demo request — use case, traffic profile, and scheduling
messages:
From: Jamie Liao <jamie@kudoscommerce.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — trial signup, quick follow-up

Hi Sergio,

We just signed up for the self-serve trial and I wanted to see if we could get a short demo to understand best practices for productionizing search & recommendation inference. High level: we’re a B2B ecommerce SaaS (Kudos Commerce) — customers upload product catalogs and we run product search + recommendations.

A couple quick things that would help before booking a time:
- Current TPS: not sure how to translate, but roughly 50k queries/day across our cluster, peaks around US business hours.
- Goal: pilot in Q3, production by end of year if pilot goes well.
- Data: mostly product metadata; no customer PII in payloads but some vendor contact emails exist.

Can you run through what you need to scope a pilot (traffic profile, model choices, infra), and share some availability this week?

Thanks,
Jamie Liao
Product Lead, Kudos Commerce
jamie@kudoscommerce.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Liao <jamie@kudoscommerce.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — trial signup, quick follow-up

Hi Jamie — thanks for signing up and for the context. Happy to walk through pilot scoping. A few quick qualification items so we tailor the demo and infrastructure suggestions:

1) Traffic shape: when you say 50k queries/day, is that 50k distinct API calls (single prompt / single result) or are there multi-round interactions per user? Also any estimate for peak concurrent requests (e.g., 20, 50, 200)?
2) Tokens / payload: are queries short (search terms) or longer structured prompts that include product descriptions? Rough estimate of tokens per request helps (avg short/avg long).
3) Timeline and success criteria for pilot: is the Q3 pilot phased (limited customers) or a full feature flag rollout?
4) Security: you mentioned vendor emails — do you need private deployment / VPC for compliance, or is hosted acceptable for pilot?

To get something on the books quickly, here are three 30-minute slots (all PDT):
- Tue May 20, 11:00–11:30
- Wed May 21, 09:30–10:00
- Wed May 21, 16:00–16:30

If none work I can send a Calendly link. Monica (cc’d) will be the onboarding lead if we move forward with a pilot.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
From: Jamie Liao <jamie@kudoscommerce.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — trial signup, quick follow-up

Thanks Sergio — answers below inline.

1) Traffic shape: 50k is API calls (one query per call). We expect around 40–60 concurrent during peak (US PST afternoon). No complex multi-round chat flows for now.
2) Tokens: most queries are short (5–20 tokens). We do some enrichment that tacks on product description chunks (avg ~120 tokens) for personalized ranking.
3) Timeline: pilot in August (select set of customers), goal to be GA by November if pilot meets latency & cost targets.
4) Security: hosted is fine for pilot. If pilot goes well we’ll evaluate Dedicated or VPC for production.

I attached a small traffic sample (kudos-traffic-sample-may2025.csv) with per-hour counts for last 14 days. Hope that helps.

Availability: Wed May 21 16:00 PDT works for us — can you confirm?

Regards,
Jamie
(Attachment: kudos-traffic-sample-may2025.csv)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Liao <jamie@kudoscommerce.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — trial signup, quick follow-up

Great — thanks for the clarifications and the sample. Wed May 21 16:00 PDT is confirmed on my calendar. I’ve pasted a short agenda below so we can use the 30 minutes efficiently:

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: intros + trial context
- 10m: traffic profile -> latency & cost expectations (we’ll reference the CSV)
- 10m: demo of config patterns (batching, caching, model selection) and pilot deployment options (hosted vs dedicated)
- 5m: next steps & mutual action plan (pilot scope, success metrics, timeline)

Monica will join at the tail end to cover onboarding checklist (sandbox creds, eval prompts, SSO).

If you need to reschedule, reply with preferred times — otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link.

See you Wednesday,
Sergio
From: Jamie Liao <jamie@kudoscommerce.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — trial signup, quick follow-up

Quick update — something came up on our side and we need to shift the call by 1 hour later. Can we move to Wed May 21 17:00–17:30 PDT instead? Same attendees (Kevin Chu from engineering will join).

Apologies for the short notice — let me know if that works and I’ll accept the updated invite.

Thanks,
Jamie
